issue.title: Render bead note attachments in gates and deliver image attachments as Telegram photos

task_type_fields.proposal: When a gate or Telegram notification includes bead note text, show attachment chips and descriptors instead of raw @attachment tokens. Deliver cached image attachments as Telegram photos, fetching from the private store within the auto-fetch cap.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-1ck covered only the CLI, pager, bead pages, and ACE TUI. Gate rendering and the sase-telegram plugin are separate surfaces, one in a separate repo, that the plan left as follow-ups.

issue.creation_reason: sase-1ck.10 (ga phase of epic sase-1ck) proposed this follow-up, and the epic plan listed it as one. Gate and Telegram surfaces currently show only the raw @attachment:<name> tokens.
